new: alternates <seats>; LEFT OUT: <seat> (<reason>), ...]". LEFT OUT (ASK 646; Init Seats output `seat_left_out`, read by Build Save Body) names each seat of the order that is not seated as panel, reserve or alternate, once, in the order's sequence, with the reason Init Seats recorded when its filter dropped the seat (the agreement filter, the debater filter, the panel filter or the alternate filter; the first reason stands, and a panel-list seat past the panel shows its alternate-filter reason), or reads "none". "[" and "]" are removed from each entry. The seating and `alt_dropped` are unchanged. When the line cannot be built it is left out and the save goes on.
